## Who may do what

For each action, the combinations `sekisho check` walked, put together where Cedar answers them alike and the same policies decide. Rows that differ in one column only are one row, the column holding their values: `any` is every value the column takes, `not …` every value but one. `-` is a column that does not apply to the row (the roles of a workflow, say).

### action `read_paper`

Read a paper

- It guards no operation.
- Principals: `Person`. Resources: `Paper`.
- 4 combinations, 1 of them allowed.

#### Allowed

| principal | member | suspended | Deciding policies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Person | yes | no | members_read |

#### Denied

- `suspended_do_nothing` (`principal is Person`, `when principal.suspended`) applies to 2 combinations, and denies each; a permit applies to 1 of them too, and the forbid wins.
- No permit applies to the 1 other combination that is denied.

<details>
<summary>The 2 rows that deny</summary>

| principal | member | suspended | Deciding policies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Person | any | yes | suspended_do_nothing |
| Person | no | no | no permit applies |

</details>

## Policies

Each policy as the `.gate` writes it, beside the Cedar `sekisho gen --target cedar` generates for it. A permit allows the combinations it applies to; a forbid denies those it applies to, and wins where a permit applies too. Cedar denies a combination no policy applies to.

### permit `members_read`

A member reads a paper

- On `read_paper`, it allows 1 combination, which no other permit allows.

`tests/gen/papers.gate`

```gate
permit members_read
  description "A member reads a paper"
  principal in member
  action read_paper
```

`cedar/papers.cedar`

```cedar
@id("papers/members_read")
@doc("A member reads a paper")
permit (
  principal in Lab::Role::"member",
  action == Lab::Action::"read_paper",
  resource is Lab::Paper
);
```

### forbid `suspended_do_nothing`

A suspended person does nothing

- A forbid written in `tests/gen/people.gate`, read with `use gate`.
- On `read_paper`, it applies to 2 combinations and denies them; a permit applies to 1 of them too.

`tests/gen/people.gate`

```gate
forbid suspended_do_nothing
  description "A suspended person does nothing"
  principal is Person
  action any
  when principal.suspended
```

`cedar/papers.cedar`

```cedar
@id("papers/people/suspended_do_nothing")
@doc("A suspended person does nothing")
forbid (
  principal is Lab::Person,
  action in [Lab::Action::"read_paper"],
  resource is Lab::Paper
)
when { principal.suspended };
```

## Roles

- `member`: A member of the lab.

Whether a principal holding one role alone (and the roles it includes) is allowed each action: always, in every combination of the rest; sometimes, allowed in some combinations and denied in others; never, denied in every one. `-` is an action that does not take the principal's type. Where a role writes `can`, `sekisho check` holds the actions it is always or sometimes allowed to it.

| principal | `read_paper` |
|---|---|
| `Person` holding `member` | sometimes |

## Operations guarded

No action guards an operation of a contract.
